cases.reviewerAnswer: Identify where the person, object or place is located.
Use the appropriate spatial expression with estar; entre links its two reference points with y.
cerca de: near; lejos de: far from; enfrente de: opposite; a la derecha/izquierda de: to the right/left of; aquí/allí: here/there.
a la derecha de = to the right of.
a la izquierda de = to the left of.
el centro = the centre; plural centros.
encima de = on top of or above.
cases.notes: The supplied gloss covers the surface-location meaning used here; the expression can also describe a position above something without contact.

cases.reviewerAnswer: entre la cama y la ventana = between the bed and the window.
Use estar with spatial expressions, distinguish the stated spatial relationships, and write del for de + el.
cases.notes: The explanation correctly allows en for surface location and the alternative spelling en frente de.

cases.reviewerAnswer: encima de; en and sobre also produce natural sentences with the requested meaning.
cases.notes: No closed key is specified, so rejection of the unlisted alternatives is not established. Llaves is treated as ordinary earlier A1 vocabulary.
